abilities.descEn: When the Ranger is defeated, it will randomly take 1 of the enemies with it. It has a high chance of activating in PVP and Guild War only, and will not activate in other battles. (Guardians will not be affected by this Ability)
abilities.descZh: 擁有此能力的Ranger被打倒時，會帶著隨機1名敵人同歸於盡。此技能僅會在PVP和公會戰中以高機率發動，其餘戰鬥中則不會發動。（隨機選擇對象不包含守護者）

abilities.descEn:
High chance of a missile being launched when deployed.
This Ability activating has no effect on the normal charge time of missiles.\n- Abilities with the same effect will not activate again for 5 seconds.\n- Rangers deploy 5 seconds after battles start.
abilities.descZh:
出動時能以高機率發射飛彈。
發動此能力時不會影響飛彈的充填時間。\n※效果相同的能力需間隔5秒才能再次發動。\n※此能力可於戰鬥開始5秒後發動。

abilities.descEn: Sometimes 1 additional Ranger is produced at no extra cost.
abilities.descZh: 以一定機率只消耗生產1隻Ranger所需的礦物量就生產出2隻Ranger。
